project: Across the Room: the far-side check
artifact_kind: unexecuted build plan; public launch optional until explicitly authorized
truth_rule: A plan, citation or teammate assertion cannot satisfy runtime evidence. Verify on the release commit.

tasks.title: Inventory, model access and team setup
acceptance: Environment and model access evidence; no application files overwritten

tasks.title: Verify rules and dependency matrix
acceptance: Cited current rule matrix, SDK/RN/OS/package pins and source dates

tasks.title: Freeze product scope and resolve ADRs
acceptance: Noise gate, privacy payload, authentication, relative-band meaning and persistence decisions

tasks.title: Run Vega hello-world and network spike
acceptance: Actual VVD boot/render/input/WSS evidence at pinned SDK

tasks.title: Run real Android microphone spike
acceptance: Physical Android experiment executed with settings, repeatability and monotonicity results; pass/fail preserved truthfully, with no automatic clinical inference

tasks.title: Decide and validate measurement mode
acceptance: Choose relative-band mode only if supported by device evidence; otherwise Listener Edition with qualified VAD/relative-only display and revised requirements; failed AGC never masquerades as valid cross-session measurement

tasks.title: Freeze versioned protocol and state machines
acceptance: Validated role/room/session/window schemas, failure states and compatibility rules

tasks.title: Implement deterministic DSP package
acceptance: Numeric, noise, clipping, VAD and boundary fixtures pass; no audio persistence

tasks.title: Implement secure local relay
acceptance: Pairing/role isolation/idempotency/expiry/abuse tests pass

tasks.title: Implement phone companion
acceptance: HTTPS permissions, mic lifecycle, privacy payload, phrase editor and wake-lock recovery

tasks.title: Implement native TV shell and focus
acceptance: Actual Vega screens and D-pad focus/navigation at supported UI scales

tasks.title: Deploy and verify AWS staging relay
acceptance: Authorized stack plan/deploy, HTTPS/WSS smoke, isolation, log redaction and cost controls

tasks.title: Implement durable TV state and deletion
acceptance: Migrations, crash-resume, idempotent summaries and complete deletion evidence

tasks.title: Integrate local full session loop
acceptance: Complete local protocol journey on supported VVD; real-phone path verified separately; secure context and evidence modes explicit

tasks.title: Verify hosted full session integration
acceptance: Real authorized staging relay phone/VVD path; authentication, no-audio transfer, expiry and recovery evidence

tasks.title: Implement three blind checks
acceptance: 3/6/9 hidden arc, rating/reveal/skip, no pre-reveal leaks

tasks.title: Implement listener controls and agreement
acceptance: Heard/Not heard, 3-cue cap, immutable window binding and late-tap exclusion

tasks.title: Implement failure recovery
acceptance: Loss/background/expiry/invalid data cancels scoring; reconnect never duplicates results

tasks.title: Run security and privacy gate
acceptance: No unresolved critical/high findings; no audio/network token/body leakage; deletion verified

tasks.title: Run TV and phone accessibility gate
acceptance: Remote-only journeys, VoiceView coordination, scaling, contrast and focus evidence

tasks.title: Run automated integration and clean-build gate
acceptance: Meaningful unit/contract/E2E/fault tests and locked clean build pass on current commit

tasks.title: Run live device and acoustic gate
acceptance: Real Android + VVD tests; delayed packets/noise tests; camera latency and limitations recorded

tasks.title: Verify production operations
acceptance: Alarms, redaction, budgets, rollback/restore drills, runbooks and artifact provenance

tasks.title: Independent adversarial release review
acceptance: Reviewer outside implementation accepts evidence or opens blocking rework tasks

tasks.title: Create engineering release candidate
acceptance: Clean pinned artifacts; all required engineering gates verified; release report has no unsupported claims

tasks.title: Prepare complete hackathon package and judge access
acceptance: Complete current-rule package and actual platform demo; licensed source/judge access prepared; publication/submission status recorded; no false readiness if required access is absent

tasks.title: Complete public-production readiness and distribution gate
acceptance: Actual target consumer hardware and support matrix verified; security/privacy/accessibility/operations signoff; signed/versioned distribution candidate and applicable certification requirements resolved; rollout prepared

tasks.title: Optional stretch after core release gates
acceptance: Separately approved why-line/starter phrases/export/Polly; all impacted gates rerun

tasks.title: Publish production release after owner authorization
acceptance: Explicit launch authorization, completed distribution/store acceptance as applicable, approved rollout and postlaunch smoke/rollback readiness; actual URL/version recorded

retry_policy.action: Record root cause; try a materially different documented recovery or mark blocked_external. Continue independent ready tasks.

continuity.checkpoint_after: Every verified task, contract change, integration, blocker and before compaction/shutdown
continuity.restart: Read checkpoint and evidence; verify git SHA/artifacts; respawn teammates; invalidate affected evidence; claim ready nodes.
